llm_response.reason: The website displays multiple classic scam characteristics: Selling popular branded products (G-Star RAW) at implausibly low prices, heavy use of urgency/discount tactics, no demonstrable company legitimacy or authorization as a dealer, and a brand/domain name ('Sanne Cortz') that does not match the brand it claims to sell. There is no transparent or verifiable corporate/legal information. These are core indicators of fake shopping scam sites.
